使用说明：
本工作流为多合一生视频工作流。如果不清楚请观看教学视频。

1.文生视频请打开：文生采样区，并且关闭首尾帧。

2.图参视频请打开：图参采样区。

3.使用二采工作流，采样区可以选择采样步数，二采步数会影响生成速度与质量，步数越少速度快，质量差 ，步数越高速度慢，质量高。

4.如果想确定视频的提示词遵循程度可以先关闭二采，然后跑一釆看下考过，确认没问题在固定种子跑二采高清视频。

widgets_values:
Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action, 16:9, 1440p, 16 seconds. A young male cultivator in a torn grey-and-black hanfu stands on a collapsing stone bridge above a mist-filled mountain ravine at dusk. Massive orange and grey clouds churn behind him, gold rim light igniting his hairline, cold blue fill from the fog below, high contrast. A battered silver sword hovers at his side, trembling with blue qi. With one palm strike he hurls it forward—the sword streaks out, leaving a cyan energy trail and shattering a falling mossy rock into debris. The camera pans right with large amplitude at fast speed following the blade. [Shot 2] At 00:001.500, the camera cuts to a close-up of the opponent—a masked cultivator in dark red robes—dodging sideways by a hair; his sleeve tears as the blade grazes past, sending a burst of dust off the stone. His eyes narrow, jaw tightens, muscles in his neck clench. [Shot 3] At 00:003.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot of the two men colliding in a burst—blades meet in a shower of orange sparks; the impact ripples outward in a ring of dust that lifts their robes and hair. He drives the blade forward with his whole weight, boots grinding against stone, breath sharp through his teeth. [Shot 4] At 00:005.500, the shot changes to an extreme close-up of their locked blades, sparks flying, tendons straining in his forearms, sweat flying off his jaw as he grits his teeth. [Shot 5] At 00:007.500, the camera cuts to a wide shot as he leaps backward onto the railing, plants his foot, and kicks off into a spinning strike; his hanfu flares open revealing a glowing silver talisman on his chest. [Shot 6] At 00:009.500, the shot cuts to the masked opponent raising both palms; a shield of pale blue energy flickers to life in front of him, the camera trucks left in a tracking shot as he slides back across the wet stone. [Shot 7] At 00:011.500, the shot transitions to a fast close-up as he stabs through the shield—the barrier cracks in a spiderweb pattern before shattering into cold blue shards; a shockwave blasts the mist outward. Reaching the opponent, he stops the point of the blade a hair's breadth from the masked cultivator's throat, a single bead of blood welling where the edge touches skin. [Shot 8] At 00:014.000, the camera cuts to an extreme close-up of his eyes, rain or sweat running down his brow, wind tossing his hair, the masked man slowly raising both hands in surrender, a deep exhaled breath steaming in the cold air.

overall_soundscape: A low mountain wind howls through the ravine. Steel rings sharply on impact, sparks crackle, stone grinding under sliding boots. His breaths come hard and fast between short gritted bursts; the shield shatters with a cold crystalline snap. Wind whips the fabric of both robes.

non_diegetic_music: Fast, driving percussive soundtrack with thundering taiko drums and metallic cymbals at 150 BPM, rising through the fast cuts and cutting to a single low, held bass tone on the final blade-to-throat beat, then fading out.
